how_to_run: Run each eval in a fresh chat with the skill installed. Evals with 'turns' are multi-turn: send each turn in order; grade the final turn. Mark each expectation pass or fail and note evidence.

evals.name: exact-daf-regression
evals.expected_output: Full v2-quality lesson on Chullin 23b, followed by the continue-learning menu and a progress line.
expectations: Teaches Chullin 23b specifically and does not call it today's daf
Contains no Daf Yomi date, countdown, or cycle progress
Includes Mishnah (or says none appears), main sugyot, Rashi/Tosafot, halacha, Aramaic, exactly 3 key takeaways, review questions, and a preview of Chullin 24a
Ends with a numbered menu listing all 7 follow-up options
Ends with a single progress-saved line (or honestly states progress could not be saved)

evals.name: followup-tosafot-no-regeneration
evals.expected_output: A Tosafot addendum only, anchored to the lesson already given.
expectations: Output is titled as an addendum on Tosafot for Chullin 23b
Does not repeat the header, the Mishnah, the sugya walkthrough, the Aramaic list, the key takeaways, or the preview
Discusses Tosafot comments not already explained in the lesson, or goes a layer deeper on ones mentioned
Re-offers only the remaining 6 options in one line

evals.name: followup-multi-select
evals.expected_output: One addendum with an Other Rishonim subsection and a Parallel sugyot subsection.
expectations: Produces one addendum with two subsections, Rishonim first, then parallels
Every Rishon discussed is attributed to a retrieved text; no Rishon is named with an invented position
Parallel sugyot give a location and explain what is shared and what differs
Does not regenerate the lesson

evals.name: followup-pdf-includes-addenda
evals.expected_output: A PDF of the lesson plus the earlier addendum, with no new source retrieval.
expectations: Delivers a PDF file
The PDF contains the original lesson and the Tosafot addendum
The PDF omits the follow-up menu and the progress line
No new Sefaria text retrieval happens for this turn

evals.name: followup-audio
evals.expected_output: An MP3 audio shiur of the lesson so far, plus its spoken script.
expectations: Delivers an MP3 (or, if no speech engine exists, the script plus a plain explanation)
Delivers the spoken script as a text file
The script contains no Hebrew-script characters, tables, URLs, or bullet lists
Review questions are followed by [pause] markers
Reports the length in minutes

evals.name: menu-omits-used-options
evals.expected_output: Lesson with Tosafot focus; menu omits option 4.
expectations: The lesson has an expanded Tosafot layer
The end menu does not list 'Go deeper on Tosafot'
The remaining options keep their original numbers (e.g. 5 is still Other Rishonim)

evals.name: yomi-with-rishonim-and-export
evals.expected_output: Today's Daf Yomi lesson with an Other Rishonim section, plus a PDF.
expectations: States Gregorian and Hebrew dates and masechet completion context
Includes an Other Rishonim section with 2 to 4 Rishonim
Delivers a PDF of the lesson
The menu omits the PDF and Other Rishonim options

evals.name: bymishnah-start-berakhot
evals.expected_output: First unit of Berakhot: Mishnah 1:1 and all its Gemara, ending where Mishnah 1:2 begins.
expectations: Header states 'Mishnah 1 of N' where N matches Sefaria's count of mishnayot in Berakhot
Header gives the exact Gemara span from Berakhot 2a
The span ends where the next Mishnah (me'eimatai korin et shema b'shacharit) begins on 9b, not at the end of 2a
The lesson is delivered in parts if too long, with Part 1 labeled 'of' the total parts
Previews the next Mishnah with its position
Contains no Daf Yomi dates or cycle progress
evals.notes: Verify the 9b boundary against a printed Gemara.

evals.name: bymishnah-bavli-order
evals.expected_output: Perek Chelek (Mishnah Sanhedrin 10:1), noting that the Bavli places this perek eleventh.
expectations: Teaches the Mishnah beginning kol Yisrael yesh lahem chelek
Notes once that the Bavli perek order differs from the Mishnah's
Does not guess boundaries if the map could not be built
evals.notes: Labels use standard Mishnah numbering, so Chelek is 10:1 even though the Bavli prints it as the eleventh perek.

evals.name: bymishnah-no-bavli
evals.expected_output: Explains that Peah has no Bavli Gemara and offers an alternative.
expectations: Does not invent a Gemara span
Offers a Mishnah-only study or another masechet

evals.name: bymishnah-natural-trigger
evals.prompt: I want to start learning Chullin mishnah by mishnah, one a day.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers without the slash command and starts ByMishnah Chullin.
expectations: The daf skill is used
Starts at the first unit of Chullin with position 'Mishnah 1 of N'

evals.name: log-show
evals.expected_output: Compact summary of last session and each track's position, no lesson.
expectations: Shows where the learner was last
Shows ByMishnah position with completed count and next unit
Does not teach a lesson

evals.name: log-continue
expectations: Teaches the second unit of Chullin, not the first
Progress line shows the updated position
evals.notes: Tests persistence across chats via the memory store.

evals.name: log-reset-confirms
expectations: Asks for confirmation before deleting progress
Does not clear other tracks

evals.name: nolog
expectations: Teaches Chullin 24a normally
Does not write to the log or memory, and has no progress-saved line

evals.name: audio-modifier-fresh
evals.expected_output: Short lesson in chat plus a 5 to 8 minute MP3.
expectations: Lesson follows short mode
Delivers an MP3 of roughly 5 to 8 minutes, plus the script
The menu omits the audio option

evals.name: rishonim-named
evals.expected_output: Prioritizes Ramban; says plainly if Ramban is unavailable on this daf.
expectations: Ramban is discussed first if available on Sefaria for this daf
If unavailable, says so rather than inventing a Ramban
Other Rishonim, if added, are clearly attributed

evals.name: followup-without-lesson
evals.expected_output: Standalone halacha discussion with a one-line context header, not a full lesson.
expectations: Traces the Gemara to later authorities (Rambam, Tur, Shulchan Arukh) with Ein Mishpat sources
Distinguishes sources from practical rulings and suggests asking a rav for personal questions
Does not produce a full lesson
evals.notes: Run in a new chat with no prior lesson.

evals.name: guard-bad-reference
evals.expected_output: Asks for a valid masechet; does not guess.
expectations: Does not substitute a similar masechet
Does not log anything
